question:
For which of the following values of a and b do the given equations, have NO solution?

x - ay = 2 - a

(1 - a)x + 6y = a + b
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ For linear equations to have no solution, the condition is: a₁ / a₂ = b₁ / b₂ ≠ c₁ / c₂. Equating coefficients of x and y: 1 ÷ (1 − a) = −a ÷ 6 ⇒ a² − a − 6 = 0 ⇒ a = 3 or −2. Based on the given options, taking a = 3, the ratio becomes −3 ÷ 6 = −1/2. Applying the inequality to constant terms: (2 − a) ÷ (a + b) ≠ −1/2. Substituting a = 3 gives: −1 ÷ (3 + b) ≠ −1/2 ⇒ 3 + b ≠ 2 ⇒ b ≠ −1. **∴ The correct answer is a = 3, b ≠ -1.**
